comment: Absolutely spine-chilling! The guide was incredibly knowledgeable and theatrically gifted. Seeing the underground vaults at night is a must-do.
Great wine selection and beautiful scenery. The lunch was fantastic. Taking one star off because the bus air conditioning wasn't working well.
A life-changing experience. The coral is vibrant and we saw three sea turtles! The crew made sure everyone felt safe in the water.
The views were spectacular, no doubt. However, the flight was much shorter than advertised, and we spent a lot of time waiting at the terminal.
Perfect way to see the city during cherry blossom season. The electric bikes made the hills easy, and the tea ceremony stop was a lovely touch.
Intense but rewarding. Not for the faint of heart! The mosquitoes are real, but sleeping in a hammock under the jungle canopy is unforgettable.
Watching the herds migrate from the air was breathtaking. The champagne breakfast in the bush afterwards was the perfect ending. Worth every penny.
Seeing the Mona Lisa without the crowds was a privilege. The guide knew everything about the Italian Renaissance. My only complaint is that 2 hours felt too short.
